_why: The PII canary (D1). ZZCANARY-OWNER-DO-NOT-PUBLISH is a planted, searchable token: verify-no-pii.mjs plants THIS FILE into a scratch copy of every published surface and asserts each surface flags it. A run where the canary is NOT flagged is a BROKEN GATE, not a clean surface. Panel A's version grepped only dist/ while the Release asset shipped ~500k owner names.
